$Comment: Ice King, step 1: scepter hit (close), ice ray (far), ice nova (punishes staying close and hitting him). Format and formulas: vanilla CAE_Skeleton_Elite and CAE_Goblin_Gobliterator_Phase1. 2026-10-22 (playtest: phase 1 = mage): after every action he steps back to 10-14 blocks (PostExecuteDistanceRange, were 6-12); MeleeHit, IceNova and IceShield are close-range punishes. 2026-10-22 harness fight (AFK player moved around him, attack counts from the Evaluator log): phase 1 cast IceRayBoth 32 % of the time (25 of 78), Zap once, the ultimate every ~40 s. IceRayBoth weight 6->4; IceRayBoth cooldown 4->8 s; FrostUltimate cooldown 40->60 s; Zap weight 3->4. 2026-10-22 (playtest: switch off friendly-fire avoidance on all his attacks; if he kills his own penguins by mistake, better, a more chaotic team fight): every action has DamageFriendlies true (AbilityCombatAction -> ActionCombatAbility -> CombatSupport.setExecutingAttack), so his ground attacks also hurt his henchmen, who list his group in DisableDamageGroups and would cancel it otherwise. They still never target him back (their Damage sensor ignores that group).

RunConditions.$Comment: Think again soon after the last action ends (about 1 s).

MeleeHit.Description: Swing the scepter at a close target. 2026-10-21: renamed ScepterHit -> MeleeHit (he holds no scepter; his close-range swing). The interaction/root keep their old file names (AT_Ice_King_Scepter_Hit). 2026-10-22 (playtest: phase 1 = mage): a punish when the player sticks to him: every 6 s at most (was 3).

Conditions.$Comment: Only within 4 blocks.

MeleeHit.$Comment: A mage: after the swing he should back off to 6-9 blocks (assumed: PostExecuteDistanceRange is where he stands after the action; to check in game).

IceRay.Description: Cast an ice bolt that slows the target. Punishes keeping the distance.

Conditions.$Comment: Better the farther the target: 0 at 3 blocks, 1 at 15.

IceNova.Description: Ground warning, then a freezing burst around the king. Answer to a target that stays close and keeps hitting. 2026-10-22 (playtest: phase 1 = mage): weight 5 (was 8), still only within 4 blocks after sustained damage. 2026-10-22 balance (picked after an art review, ice-king-balance-review.md): RecentSustainedDamage is a Switch at 10.

Ice_Nova_Damage.$Comment: Required: the Replace DefaultValue is not used for NPCs (SEVERE 'Missing replacement interactions' without this). Plain id form as the Skeleton_Elite Shield_Guard_End var.

Conditions.$Comment: Only within 4 blocks.

2026-10-22 balance: Switch 0->1 at 10 recent damage (was InverseExponential). That curve is 1.1*(x-0.1)^0.28: below 10 % of its XRange Math.pow of a negative base gives NaN, which passed the clamp and won the evaluation, so this fired when NOT being hit (review). Switch as the Gobliterator's FurnaceBlast.

Iceberg.Description: Raise the hands and call the icebergs: sends the beacon AT_Ice_King_Iceberg, the encounter drops one on every player. Punishes standing still.

Summon.Description: Summon 2 frost skeletons. Only when none of them is alive and the king is under 800 health. Conditions as the vanilla CAE_Skeleton_Praetorian Summon and CAE_Goblin_Glutton. 2026-10-22 balance (picked after an art review, ice-king-balance-review.md): NearbyCount Switch 5 (was 9): 10-12 Gunters could pile up (about 20-26 damage/s, more than the king).

Conditions.$Comment: 1 while fewer than 9 Gunters (group Gunters) are within 30 blocks, 0 from 9 on: 2 more makes 10 at most.
1 below 400 health (MaxHealth 500 for testing: 80%; 2400 of 3000 for the real fight), 0 above.

IceRayFreezing.Description: Rare ice ray whose hit also freezes 1.5 s. Same conditions as IceRay, weight 1 (the minimum the engine accepts; IceRay has 4) and a lower Randomiser (0.2-0.8 instead of 0.7-1), so roughly 1 ray in 7 is this one. 2026-10-22 balance (picked after an art review, ice-king-balance-review.md): weight 5 (was 1), Randomiser 0.6-1 (0.2-0.8), cooldown 25 s (8): it fired about once in 13 min; now roughly every 25-30 s.

Conditions.$Comment: Better the farther the target: 0 at 3 blocks, 1 at 15.

Zap.Description: Zap (2026-10-21): quick weak ice bolt straight at the target, 0.35 s charge, 8 damage. Fills the gaps between the big spells at mid and long range.

Conditions.$Comment: Every 4 s at most.
Better the farther the target: 0 at 3 blocks, 1 at 15.

IceShield.Description: Defens-ice (2026-10-21): 3 s of ice shield (no damage), then the shell bursts in a 5-block circle (15 ice, push, 2 frost stacks). Answer to taking a lot of damage, at any range. 2026-10-21: v3, up to 8 s, every 5 hits taken cut 4 s, warning only in the last 1.5 s; it already prefers moments when he has taken a lot of damage (RecentSustainedDamage condition). 2026-10-22 (playtest: phase 1 = mage): only within 6 blocks (was 0-20), a close-range answer. 2026-10-22 balance (picked after an art review, ice-king-balance-review.md): RecentSustainedDamage is a Switch at 20.

Conditions.$Comment: Every 25 s at most.

2026-10-22 balance: Switch 0->1 at 20 recent damage (was InverseExponential). That curve is 1.1*(x-0.1)^0.28: below 10 % of its XRange Math.pow of a negative base gives NaN, which passed the clamp and won the evaluation, so this fired when NOT being hit (review). Switch as the Gobliterator's FurnaceBlast.

IceRain.Description: Ice rain (2026-10-21): bolt into the sky, then the encounter drops 10 marked shards around every player (12 ice + 1 frost stack each). Punishes standing still; needs the encounter.

Conditions.$Comment: Every 30 s at most.

IceBurst.Description: Ice burst (2026-10-21): 1.6 s charge standing still, 6 quick throws alternating left/right hand, one bolt each (5 x 8 + 20 damage, a frost stack each, push on the last), 1 s recovery. A separate attack from IceBurstBoth (playtest: two different attacks), every 25 s at most.

Conditions.$Comment: Every 25 s at most.
Better the farther the target: 0 at 4 blocks, 1 at 14.

FrostUltimate.Description: Ultimate 'Ice... KING!' (2026-10-21): the giant ice beam, Nightlord technique. 1.8 s wind-up standing still, then a 24-block hit line ticking every 0.4 s for 2.8 s (6 x 12 + 24 = 96 ice damage, a frost stack each tick), 1.2 s recovery. Rare (every 40 s at most), mid to long range. Range 6-50 blocks (2026-10-21, was 6-20; the beam reaches 60).

Conditions.$Comment: Every 40 s at most.
Better the farther the target: 0 at 5 blocks, 1 at 15.

FrostUltimateRage.Description: Rage ultimate (2026-10-21): the same giant beam, but it follows the player (Root_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Rage). Kept OUT of the Default ActionSet: only for testing on the ground (ice-king-attacks.py solo 1 FrostUltimateRage); its real place is the rage phase. Range 6-50 blocks (2026-10-21, was 6-20; the beam reaches 60).

Conditions.$Comment: Every 40 s at most.
Better the farther the target: 0 at 5 blocks, 1 at 15.

IceBurstBoth.Description: Two-arm ice burst (2026-10-21): 1.6 s charge standing still, 4 throws with both arms, one bolt from each hand per throw (6 x 8 + 2 x 20, 8 frost stacks, push on the last pair), 1 s recovery. A separate attack from IceBurst, every 30 s at most.

Conditions.$Comment: Every 30 s at most.
Better the farther the target: 0 at 4 blocks, 1 at 14.

IceRayBoth.Description: Two-hand ice throw (2026-10-21: a separate attack, the most common of his throws): 0.6 s charge, one throw with both hands, a bolt from each (2 x 8 Ice, 2 frost stacks). Every 4 s at most, weight 6 (the one-hand IceRay has 4), so it comes up more often than the one-hand ray.

Conditions.$Comment: Every 4 s at most.
Better the farther the target: 0 at 3 blocks, 1 at 15.

IceSwordSlash.Description: Ice sword slash (2026-10-21, concept attack 5, ground version): 0.6 s summoning the sword, then a chop on everything within 3.5 blocks (28 ice, push, 2 frost stacks). Close range, every 12 s at most. 2026-10-21: not in phase 1 any more (taken out of ActionSets), the sword is only for the nunchuck phase (CAE_AT_Ice_King_Fridjitzu).

Conditions.$Comment: Every 12 s at most.

IceSwordSlash.$Comment: A mage: after the swing he should back off to 6-9 blocks (assumed: PostExecuteDistanceRange is where he stands after the action; to check in game).
